data.title: 萝丝 · 雪夜古堡之巅的细剑疾刺
data.description: 风雪交加的雪山古堡城垛边缘，黑色斗篷在狂风中猎猎作响。萝丝单手持细剑直刺向前，剑尖凝聚着炽烈魔力，金色卷发如光辉般绚烂绽放。
data.location: snowy battlements atop a fortified mountain fortress under blizzard skies
data.action: lunging forward in a graceful fencing thrust with glowing rapier, black cloak swirling in the biting blizzard, fierce golden curls
data.lighting: chilly blue snowstorm lighting with brilliant crimson magical spark on rapier tip
data.mood: heroic resolution, rebirth in shadows, fierce warrior princess spirit
data.promptProse: On a snowy fortress wall in a blizzard, hooded Rose in black slime suit thrusts forward with her glowing rapier.
